title: Minimum Cost to Reach Destination in Time

monster.name: Toll Spectre
monster.title: Tribute Master of Timed Transit
monster.defeatQuote: Minimum passing fee under maxTime deadline computed!

description: There is a country of `n` cities numbered from 0 to n - 1. You are given `maxTime`, a 2D integer array `edges` where `edges[i] = [ui, vi, timei]`, and an integer array `passingFees` of length `n`. Return the minimum fee to reach city n - 1 from city 0 in at most `maxTime` minutes, or `-1` if there is no such journey.
starterCode:
def minCost(maxTime: int, edges: list[list[int]], passingFees: list[int]) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def minCost(maxTime: int, edges: list[list[int]], passingFees: list[int]) -> int:
    import heapq
    from collections import defaultdict
    n = len(passingFees)
    graph = defaultdict(list)
    for u, v, t in edges:
        graph[u].append((v, t))
        graph[v].append((u, t))
    min_time = [float('inf')] * n
    pq = [(passingFees[0], 0, 0)]
    min_time[0] = 0
    while pq:
        cost, time, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if u == n - 1: return cost
        for v, t in graph[u]:
            nt = time + t
            if nt <= maxTime and nt < min_time[v]:
                min_time[v] = nt
                heapq.heappush(pq, (cost + passingFees[v], nt, v))
    return -1
hints: Modified Dijkstra keeping track of best arrival time at each node.
